title: Adjoint identity for mollification: ∫ D(η⋆u)(s) = −∫ u · div(η̌⋆s) for C¹ compactly supported η
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ℝ^P = Euclid P with Lebesgue measure, and div G := trace DG. Let η : ℝ^P → ℝ be C¹ with compact support and put η̌(z) := η(−z). Let u : ℝ^P → ℝ and s : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be integrable. Write (k ⋆ a)(x) := ∫ k(t) a(x − t) dt (Mathlib's convolution with lsmul ℝ ℝ and volume). Then ∫ D(η ⋆ u)(x)(s(x)) dx = −∫ u(z) div(η̌ ⋆ s)(z) dz.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (η u : Euclid P → ℝ) (s : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → Integrable u → Integrable s → ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (convolution η u (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x (s x) = -∫ z, u z * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ (convolution (fun z => η (-z)) s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)
